title: Microglial clearance of Alzheimer's amyloid-beta obstructed by nanoplastics
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00291E, Paper
Yue Wang, Gangtong Huang, Xiufang Liang, Nicholas Andrikopoulos, Huayuan Tang, Feng Ding, Pu Chun Ke, Yuhuan Li
Amyloid beta spontaneously renders a protein corona on the polystyrene (PS) nanoplastic surface, hindering clearance of the peptide by microglia to amplify neuroimmune dysfunction and Alzheimer's pathology.
